jcr:title: RISE
jcr:description: RISE is Stryker’s integrated surgical platform for ENT and neurosurgery - built to streamline your OR with advanced surgical visualization, control, and connectivity. See the difference. Fill out the form to experience the RISE!

text_54143830.text:
Welcome to the RISE of a new OR for ENT and Neurosurgery.

RISE integrates existing Stryker solutions to create a connected surgical experience tailored just for you. Designed to improve workflow efficiencies to create a better surgical experience.2

text.text:
Your OR. Your way.

  • An OR designed for you
  • Helps reduce footprint
  • Designed to improve workflow efficiencies2

text_copy.text:
Connectivity

  • Devices in harmony
  • Multiple touchpoints
  • Flow from surgery to surgery

Visualization

  • Vibrant surgical image
  • 62.5x more visible colors1,3
  • Sinuscope cleaning with Hydro irrigation system

text_1135547758_copy.text: From conveniently mobile Neurotechnology Carts to permanently installed iSuites, RISE is a surgical evolution that can be customized and configured to meet your needs. Choose an experience that works for you and your team.

largeheadline_136038.line2: The RISE Neurotechnology Cart

text_1957643662.text: The customizable RISE Neurotechnology Cart accommodates unique demands of the RISE Ecosystem in ENT and Neurosurgery.2

text_1509719914.text: Click and drag the cart for a 360° view or use the arrows below to rotate.

text.text: • Storage for EM generator and flex arm of the Stryker ENT navigation system
• Storage drawer for cables and foot pedal

As the command center for RISE, the Connected OR Hub facilitates connectivity and allows you to control your devices from multiple touch points.

  • Capture and record
  • Custom surgeon profiles
  • Voice activation
  • Device control in and outside of the sterile field
Your team can assist you from the doc station without breaking sterility around the sterile field.4

largeheadline.line2: Surgeon profiles and equipment checklist

text_copy.text: Your team taps your custom profile, and the equipment checklist guides setup.

text_260076128_copy_.text: Foot pedal consolidation reduces OR clutter and provides surgeons choice of device management.2

text_1770451583.text: RISE integrates clear, vivid surgical images with the 1788 platform, Stryker's most vibrant surgical 4K image ever.3

largeheadline.line2: Real-time device statuses
Integrated camera head

text.text:
Tone mode

Balance brightness and illuminate shadows across the field of view by enhancing posterior lighting without compromising foreground detail.3

text_copy.text:
Full frame HDR

High dynamic range (HDR), is designed to provide more detail in shadows and highlights of the image.3

Experience one billion colors

62.5x more colors1,3

Fluorescence imaging

Experience clearer delineation of fluorescence signal designed for improved visualization of critical anatomy and perfusion.1,3

largeheadline_copy_c_353078774.line2: Get the full scope

text.text: Integrated and voice activated, the 1788 AIM platform* and Hydro irrigation system designed to maintain clear visualization during surgery.3
Integrated and voice activated, the 1788 AIM platform* and Hydro irrigation system designed to maintain clear visualization during surgery.3

largeheadline_1722649611.line1: Just say, "clean scope."2
